name: Pasta Design Tokens
description: Semantic design tokens for Pasta file converter macOS AppKit and Figma integration

accent-primary.description: Primary brand accent (deep sunset stop), used for active rings, progress highlights, and buttons

accent-ink.description: Dark ink typography used on vibrant orange surfaces (#FF9E33) to guarantee 8.9:1 contrast (WCAG AAA)

text-primary.description: Primary readable text on dark macOS materials

text-tertiary.description: Calibrated tertiary hint text; raised to 55% white to ensure at least 4.5:1 contrast against dark obsidian surfaces

surface-obsidian-top.description: Top stop of obsidian squircle background

surface-obsidian-bottom.description: Bottom stop of obsidian squircle background

border-subtle.description: Subtle border around inactive slices and card boundaries

surface-wheel.description: Translucent HUD window material for center disc and radial node backing

surface-popover.description: Native macOS NSPopover surface for status bar drop window

surface-sidebar.description: Sidebar vibrancy material for list and settings panels

spatial-bloom.description: CASpringAnimation values for radial node staggered opening and blooming from center

spatial-dismiss.description: CASpringAnimation values for rapid, non-distracting node collapse and dismissal

hover-scale.description: Micro-interaction spring for node hover and drag-over, strictly clamped between 1.0 and 1.06

shiftHoldDurationMs.description: Threshold duration required to hold Shift while dragging a file to open wheel

chargingRingDelayMs.description: Delay before cursor charging progress ring appears

optionTapMaxDurationMs.description: Maximum duration of Option key press to qualify as a tap mode toggle

interaction.hintPillText: Hold ⇧ to open · Esc cancels · tap ⌥ switches Convert / Advanced
